title: Fidelity record, version 1 (osd.fidelity/1)
description: What a workspace did with the files of one catalogue record: per input file, which canonical output it became, with which converter, and which inputs did not convert. Written by Ophiolite from Ophiolite's provenance record (E127), read by `osd verify <id> --fidelity-from`. The catalogue derives its own `canonical-conversion` check from it and never takes a level or any other check from it; nothing else is admitted here.

inputs.description: One result per landed file; the catalogue awards L4 only when every file of its latest verification has one

catalog.description: The catalogue snapshot, copied whole from records.json `catalog` (manifest/3 `metadata.catalog`). records_digest is the sha256 of the records array as canonical JSON: keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8, no escaping of non-ASCII

source_commit.description: Commit of the repository the catalogue was built from; null outside git

verification_commit.description: Commit of the verification-results branch the levels came from; null when the build was not told

sha256.description: Of the landed bytes; must be a file of the catalogue's latest verification

name.description: The manifest asset key the file landed as

representative.description: A few values a person can compare with the source (a curve's first sample, a header field)

kind.description: The workspace's canonical kind (Ophiolite kind registry, E55)

id.description: The workspace item the input became
